about.title: About Me
about.description: I'm a resourceful and adaptable designer with a passion for learning and a proven ability to master new tools and concepts quickly. My background blends design, art, and front-end development, allowing me to navigate complex challenges and deliver elegant solutions. I am committed to growing professionally and contributing my skills to a collaborative and successful team.

experience.title: Freelance Designer & Generalist
